items.problem: UWP toast migration to AppNotificationManager crashed at startup (0xc000027b) for lack of the Register() lifecycle + manifest COM activator, so the agent reverted to the UWP ToastNotificationManager (latent runtime defect for unpackaged desktop).
items.evidence: lessons.json dev_agent_struggles[0] + errors_encountered[0]; session-log turns 40-46 (add AppNotificationManager.Default.Register() -> Test-AppLaunch FAIL 0xc000027b -> revert DisplayToast to Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager).
items.root_cause: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#notifications gave only a 2-row mapping table + doc link: no registration lifecycle, no manifest activator requirement, no warning against reverting to the UWP API.
items.change: Strengthened the #notifications section with (1) the Register()/Unregister() startup lifecycle, (2) an AppNotificationBuilder + Show before/after snippet, (3) the required windows.toastNotificationActivation + windows.comServer manifest extensions, and (4) an explicit 'do not revert to ToastNotificationManager (parameterless CreateToastNotifier() throws unpackaged)' callout.
items.expected_effect: On re-run, an agent migrating toasts uses AppNotificationManager with correct Register() + manifest and does not revert to the UWP API.
items.falsifiable_check: A UWP-toast scenario builds AND launches without 0xc000027b while using Microsoft.Windows.AppNotifications (no residual Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager.CreateToastNotifier in migrated source).

items.problem: The 0xC000027B startup-crash guidance nudged the agent to defer/remove the startup API rather than fix its registration, reinforcing the revert.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#startup-crashes line 387 ('if unsupported ... defer it'); Test-AppLaunch hint at session-log turn 42; agent removed Register() at turn 45.
items.root_cause: The 0xC000027B row named only the generic 'legacy projection/activation incompatibility -> defer' path, not the common concrete COM-activator-registration cause.
items.change: Extended the 0xC000027B row: name AppNotificationManager.Default.Register() with a missing manifest activator as a common concrete cause; declare the extension and keep the API rather than deferring/reverting.
items.expected_effect: Agents triaging 0xC000027B after adding notification/COM-activator registration fix the manifest instead of reflexively deferring the API.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run of a notification scenario, crash triage resolves to a manifest fix (activator extensions added) and the WinAppSDK notification API is retained.

deferred_to_human: Tier-1 idea (out of scope for auto-apply): teach Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 / unsupported-api-inventory.json to warn when Microsoft.Windows.AppNotifications is used but no windows.toastNotificationActivation extension is declared in the manifest, and/or flag a residual adaptable ToastNotificationManager.CreateToastNotifier() left post-migration.
